description: National Road Network Sinuosity Index is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Infrastructure Ireland. For each record (about 5,500 in total and each represents about 1km of the network) the sinuosity is calculated. It is a ratio of the actual length over the shortest path defined by the start and end nodes of the 1 km section. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Infrastructure Ireland. Its tags are national roads, road safety, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in KML, SHP / ZIP. The portal shows 2018-03-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
